summary: Currenc Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K press release announcing FY2025 financial results. The release mentions a proposed reverse merger with Animoca Brands (announced November 2025) and a planned sale of Tranglo for US$400 million, but neither transaction is executed or detailed in this filing. No definitive agreement, terms, or board recommendation are included. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situations event.
